operations.name: searchMedia
operations.description: Shows the media items, 50 at a time, in the order the app shows them.

title.description: Only show media with exactly this title. Leave it out to show every title.

categoryName.description: Only show media in this category. Leave it out to show every category.

subcategoryName.description: Only show media in this subcategory of the category given. Leave it out to show the whole category.

page.description: Which page of 50 to show, counting from 0. Leave it out for the first page.

callback.description: Runs when the search is done.

error.description: Why it didn't work, such as no category having that name.

media.description: The media items on this page, in the order the app shows them.

summary.description: The short summary shown in the list.

topImage.description: The image shown in the list.

image.description: The image shown while the audio plays.

backgroundImage.description: The background shown while the audio plays.

srcUrl.description: The link to the original source.

subcategories.description: The ids of the subcategories it is in.

rank.description: Its place in the manual order.

deepLinkUrl.description: The link that opens it in the app.

views.description: How many times it was played, when view counts are shown; otherwise empty.

total.description: How many media items match in all.

page.description: Which page this is, counting from 0.
